Dra. Beatriz Matos
Junior Associate Lawyer | Bar Association License No. 54192L
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Qualified legal practitioner admitted to the Bar, focusing on commercial contract drafting, corporate
advisory, and litigation assistance.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Junior Associate Lawyer
Matos & Associados Law Firm (2021-Present)
Drafting and revising commercial agreements.
Corporate governance, including incorporations, board resolutions, and articles of association.
Preparing court pleadings, alongside doctrinal and jurisprudential legal research.
EDUCATION
Master's in Forensic Law and Arbitration - University of Lisbon School of Law (2019-2021)
LL.B. / Bachelor of Laws (2015-2019)
EXPERTISE & SKILLS
Commercial & Corporate Law, Contract Drafting, Civil Litigation, Case Law Research, Negotiation &
Mediation, Legal Database Systems.
